The '''Event Organization Advocate''' is the eighth seat on the [[Players Committee]]'s Advocate Council, first listed on the Community Card of March 2026.<ref name="card2026">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Communitycard.html Community Card, Advocate Council tab], res.starwarsccg.org (file dated 18 March 2026)</ref> The current Event Organization Advocate is [[Karl Koenig]].
